lead.title: Nvidia memory supply commitments soar to $279B as NVHBM cuts HBM power 15%
lead.summary: TrendForce reports Nvidia's HBM supply commitments have ballooned to $279B as the DRAM/HBM crunch keeps memory prices climbing through 2028. Nvidia's custom NVHBM design moves the memory controller to the base die for up to 30% more bandwidth at 15% lower power — a shift that keeps raising the cost floor for consumer and local inference rigs.

top_stories.title: singular-lite: multi-agent orchestration engine for software repos
top_stories.summary: Autonomous multi-agent engine with L0/L1/L2 agents, leases, gates, audits and Git-worktree isolation with detached dispatch by default.

top_stories.title: Understudy: scenario testing for AI agents
top_stories.summary: Open-source tool for defining and running scenario-based agent tests, validating behavior against expected outcomes before deployment.

items.title: Puro-2B: 2B model pretrained on a single RTX 5090 within a $5,090 budget
items.summary: Open-source, cost-efficient pretraining recipe that trains a Qwen2-based 2B model on one consumer RTX 5090, aimed at making small-model pretraining accessible.

items.title: FOCUS & RePAIR: mitigating text degeneration in pruned LLMs
items.summary: Shows pruning amplifies repetition loops even when perplexity and accuracy hold, and proposes token-level decoding guidance to fix this failure mode.

items.title: Beyond Parallel Blindness: information floors in speculative decoding
items.summary: Separates within-block path information loss from imperfect modeling to define an information floor for block drafters in speculative decoding.
